feeds.title: The Local Project Magazine
feeds.description: The Local Project was born out of a desire to showcase Australia's rich design industry. They span architecture, interiors, and product design, and are one of the fastest-growing design-based platforms. Driven by curious and innovative creatives, they seek to champion the best from industry leaders & emerging designers alike.

feeds.title: Wolf Architects Blog
feeds.description: WOLF ARCHITECTS architect firm is an award winning international practice with its headquarters based in Melbourne, Australia. From small low cost houses to high rise commercial and high end multi-level residential projects, we aim to surpass client expectations.

feeds.title: Versatile Structures Blog
feeds.description: Versatile Structures is a Brisbane-based Company and we pride ourselves on our diverse portfolio, including projects in the sport, leisure, retail, residential, industrial, and commercial sectors. Delivering high-quality shade solutions and Structures.

feeds.title: CO-architecture
feeds.description: Site is a publication and blog dedicated to showcasing Australia's best interior design and architecture. Feature articles, news, architecture jobs & more! CO-architecture is a dynamic team of architects, designers, and marketers with a key focus: to serve as the leading network and resource for discovering and connecting with design professionals across Australia.

feeds.title: Baahouse Architecture Blog
feeds.description: Blogs include granny flats vs aged care, Why granny flats are popular in Avalon beach, National design award, trending products & materials. Baahouse Architecture specializes in designing small to medium sized homes including second dwellings. They are architecturally designed, unique, designed for the Australian climate and most importantly, customised to suit your site location. We are the experts in ensuring your small home is aesthetic, functional and enjoyable to live in.

feeds.title: DGK Blog
feeds.description: A multi-disciplinary architectural practice focusing on architecture, interior design and 3D animation. Our expertise are in residential, commercial, resorts, retail & heritage, with a portfolio of projects nationally and internationally. Explore the blog to know more about our ongoing projects, architecture trends, tips and more!

feeds.title: Lea Design Studio Blog
feeds.description: Our blog allows us to share our projects, processes and any exciting news with our community. We are a boutique architectural practice focused on producing innovative, functional and aesthetically inspiring designs for our Clients. With extensive experience gained over 30 years working as an Architect, an Architect Developer, and a Developer's Architect, founder John Lea is uniquely positioned to understand what a Client expects and the services required from their Architect.

feeds.title: Architeria Architects Blog
feeds.description: Architeria Architects in Melbourne & Sydney is a registered architectural practice and a member of the Australian Institute of Architects, providing professional services in all aspects of Architecture & Planning. Explore more about architecture in Australia, trends, technology and more!

feeds.title: Australian Institute of Architects
feeds.description: The Australian Institute of Architects is the peak body for the architectural profession, representing 12,000 members in professional practice and education. It has national and state offices across Australia. It provides access to Australian Standards, ABIC building industry contracts, publications, and HR and legal advice. It conducts policy and advocacy on behalf of its members and the building industry. Keep up to date with the latest news and updates.

feeds.title: ArchitectureAU
feeds.description: ArchitectureAU.com, launched in November 2011, is a continually updated online resource for anyone interested in our built environment. It is a dynamic website providing extensive, focused coverage of the news of the day, exclusive commentary from leading writers, practitioners, academics, and critics, and an ever-expanding archive of realized work.

feeds.title: Ballast Point Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest news, updates and special offers. The Ballast Point philosophy is grounded in authenticity, respect and excellence to help our clients create extraordinary things. We treat every project as if it were our own house, harnessing the team's design and construction experience to produce quality results.

feeds.title: Yellowtrace » Architecture
feeds.description: Yellowtrace is an influential and award-winning online design publication. Started in 2010 as Dana's passion project, Yellowtrace quickly gained powerful momentum and gathered a loyal following amongst the local and global design community, and those passionate about design in all its forms. The site is updated daily, Monday through Friday, with carefully curated, cutting-edge, and highly researched content in the areas of Interior Design, Architecture, Art, Photography, Travel & Design Culture.

feeds.title: Art and Architecture, mainly
feeds.description: Discover the articles on history, art history and architecture of Britain & Empire, Europe, Mediterranean & North America from 1640-1940.

feeds.title: Est Living Magazine
feeds.description: Curating the best in Australian and international interior design, home decor, open house & house inspiration ideas. Global living with an Australian twist. Est finds unexpected architecture and interiors, then handpicks the best to inspire you. We profile leaders in global project and product design.

feeds.title: SQM Architects Blog
feeds.description: At SQM Architects, we craft custom-tailored design solutions for spaces of all scales and styles, laying a solid foundation for successful property development. Best of all, we streamline the process so you can hit your target on time and under budget. Browse through our property development insights and tips.

feeds.title: Mark Lawler Architects Blog
feeds.description: Check out our blog to help your home to become fantastic, incredible and amazing. At Mark Lawler Architects, we believe that the most important attributes of an Architect are creative problem-solving skills combined with technical knowledge and an understanding of our human aspirations. Our highly qualified team have gained broad valuable experience in the Sydney and Canberra markets as well as the local Newcastle and Lake Macquarie context.

feeds.title: Joe Adsett Architects Blog
feeds.description: Joe Adsett Architects are a national award-winning studio specializing in luxury residential architecture, interior design, and multi-residential developments. Stay up to date with the latest news on our projects, architecture tips, inspirations and more!

feeds.title: Mileham Blog
feeds.description: Mileham's blog answers frequently asked architecture, building, renovation, budget and design questions to help you get the best possible result possible for your next project. Mileham is an award-winning, full-service architectural design and construction firm delivering beautiful and bespoke residential homes and developments for private clients in Sydney and its surrounding regions.

feeds.title: Habitus Living
feeds.description: Habitus explores the best residential architecture & design in Australia / Asia Pacific; interior design, house architecture, architects, designer hunters.

feeds.title: Australian Design Review
feeds.description: Australian Design Review was founded in 2009 as the online home for Niche Media's architecture and design publications, bringing together content from Architectural Review, inside (interior design review) and the more recently launched MEZZANINE. ADR is now the go-to industry resource for news, events, jobs and features about the architecture, interiors and design disciplines.

feeds.title: Dion Seminara Architecture Blog
feeds.description: With over 30 years in architectural home design, we have created many forever homes! And we are here to help you achieve your forever home. Below we have written and compiled a range of resources, articles, tips, and advice. These will ensure you are aware of the endless opportunities, joy, and value that forever architectural home design offers. Dion Seminara Architecture is the place where dream homes become a reality. It starts with getting a deep understanding of your needs. Every home is different, which is why we create bespoke designs that really work for you.

feeds.title: The Design Files » Architecture
feeds.description: Discover award-winning Australian architecture, inspiring architect-designed homes and interviews with Australia's top architects. The Design Files is Australia's most popular digital design publication. We cover real Australian homes, gardens, art, architecture, interior design, furniture, textiles, homewares, food, and more!
